messages:
zhen: midday async — quick status: finished a full eval sweep for tinyq-v2 on the spanish promptset. overall metrics look okay but found a consistent under-generation for long-turn dialogs (~15% drop in length relative to baseline).

maya: thanks. any pattern on prompts? specific tokens or prefix structure?

zhen: seems tied to prompts with multi-step instructions (’step 1:, step 2:’). shorter single-shot prompts are fine. suspect the prompt normalization we applied in the tokenizer wrapper removed some trailing whitespace that the model relied on.

liam: can repro locally on a quick run. running the same eval command now:```bash
./scripts/run_eval.sh --model tinyq-v2 --prompts data/spanish/multistep.jsonl --seed 42 --save outputs/tinyq-v2/multi-2026-03-17
```

maya: fwiw the new tokenizer change was in PR 4821 — it trims duplicated whitespace in normalization. maybe too aggressive.

zhen: @liam mind opening a tiny experiment to toggle the trim flag off and re-run single-batch? would like a quick A/B.

liam: yep, will do. ETA ~30m. will post artifacts.

eval-bot: automated summary: run_id=tinyq-v2-multi-2991234567, rouge=0.42 (±0.03), avg_len=28.3, baseline_avg_len=33.6, quality_drop_flag=true

olivia: is this blocking the canary rollout for tinyq-v2? product asked if we can go live today.

rafael: not a hard block yet. if the shorter outputs materially affect UX we should pause. but if it's a tokenization regress we can patch and roll quickly. @zhen, do you want dedicated PR for tokenizer tweak + unit tests?

zhen: yes i'll open a targeted PR to revert the whitespace trim for now and add a unit test covering multi-step prompts. will link it here. (also leaving notes for QA on promptset id 2026-03-spanish-multi)

liam: quick heads-up — found an extra strip call in tokenizer.normalize(). patch works locally, reproduces baseline length when disabled. pushing a draft branch `fix/tokenizer-strip-299` and will attach a short smoke-run artifact.

maya: thanks both. once liam posts artifacts i'll run the eval harness against the gating suite. if green we can proceed with a canary at 10% and watch the metrics dash.

rafael: assigning code review to @liam and @zhen. I'll handle the canary config if we get the green light. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood-inference/prompting/+/draft-fix/tokenizer-strip-299

zhen: tagging this for follow-up: add a promptset regression test to the onboarding pipeline so future tokenizer changes run the multi-step spanish set automatically.

liam: artifact: https://artifacts.redwood.ai/2991234567/tinyq-v2-multi-smoke.zip (logs + examples).

maya: I'll schedule a short async-check in 1hr to confirm gating results. if anyone wants to sync live ping me. :thumbsup:

olivia: great, thanks.

(eval-bot): note — alert threshold rule "gating-length-delta" triggered for model tinyq-v2, flagged for review.
